buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Generic OPTION CLAUSE: The Purchaser reserves the right to increase or decrease the quantity to be ordered up to 25 percent of bid quantity at the time of placement of contract. The purchaser also reserves the right to increase the ordered quantity up to 25% of the contracted quantity during the currency of the contract at the contracted rates. The delivery period of quantity shall commence from the last date of original delivery order and in cases where option clause is exercised during the extended delivery period the additional time shall commence from the last date of extended delivery period. The additional delivery time shall be (Increased quantity ÷ Original quantity) × Original delivery period (in days), subject to minimum of 30 days. If the original delivery period is less than 30 days, the additional time equals the original delivery period. The Purchaser may extend this calculated delivery duration up to the original delivery period while exercising the option clause. Bidders must comply with these terms. 2. Generic Bidder financial standing: The bidder should not be under liquidation, court receivership or similar proceedings, should not be bankrupt. Bidder to upload undertaking to this effect with bid. 3. Scope of Supply Scope of supply (Bid price to include all cost components) : Supply Installation Testing Commissioning of Goods and Training of operators and providing Statutory Clearances required (if any) 4. Service & Support Availability of Service Centres: Bidder/OEM must have a Functional Service Centre in the State of each Consignee's Location in case of carry-in warranty. (Not applicable in case of goods having on-site warranty). If service center is not already there at the time of bidding, successful bidder / OEM shall have to establish one within 30 days of award of contract. Payment shall be released only after submission of documentary evidence of having Functional Service Centre. 5. Service & Support

Dedicated /toll Free Telephone No. for Service Support : BIDDER/OEM must have Dedicated/toll Free Telephone No. for Service Support. 6. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses 1. Bid-Specific OEM Authorization: The bidder shall submit a bid-specific authorization certificate issue d by the Original Equipment Manufacturer (OEM) at the time of bid submission. The authorization shall be duly confirmed by the OEM and must include the GeM Reference Number and the details of the authorize d OEM representative, including name, designation, address, email ID and contact number. 2. Technical Data sheets and Certifications: The bidder shall upload the technical datasheets, along with all relevant certifications of each hardware component offered, at the time of submission of the bid. 3. Service Centre in Puducherry: The bidder must have an established service centre within the Union Territory of Puducherry to ensure ti mely after-sales service and maintenance. The complete address and contact telephone number of the se rvice centre shall be furnished along with the bid document. 4. Right to Cancel or Amend the Tender: The Purchaser reserves the right to cancel the tender or amend any of its terms and conditions at any sta ge, without assigning any reason and without prior notice to the bidders. 5. Issue Resolution and Rectification: The successful bidder shall ensure that any reported hardware or software-relatedissue is rectified within a maximum period of two (2) days from the date of receipt of the complaint. 6. Supply of Accessories and Connectivity: The bidder shall quote inclusive of all necessary network c ables and accessories required for installation and connectivity of all computer systems, printers, printer s tands and stabilizers. The bidder shall ensure proper connectivity and functioning of all supplied equipme nt. 7. OEM Website Details: The bidder shall provide the official website link of the OEM to enable the Purc haser to verify the product specifications, warranty details and OEM authenticity. The OEM website must a lso provide facilities for online breakdown complaint registration and service request tracking. The OEM's official email address for breakdown complaint registration shall also be furnished. 8. Installation by OEM-Authorized Service Centre: Installation and commissioning of all supplied equi pment shall be carried out exclusively by the OEM or its duly authorized service centre to verify the genui neness and authenticity of the products supplied. The bidder shall submit appropriate proof of OEM author ization and installation completion. 9. Warranty and After-Sales Support: The successful bidder shall ensure that all supplied product s are genuine, brand-new and covered under a comprehensive three (3) years OEM warranty fr om the date of installation and commissioning. Warranty and after-sales support shall be provided directly through the OEM or its authorized service network. 10. Compliance with Tender Conditions: The bidder shall ensure strict compliance with all the above t erms and conditions. Failure to comply with any of the stipulated requirements may result in rejection of t he bid. .
